readme_excerpt: The Odin Project The Odin Project (TOP) is an open-source curriculum for learning full-stack web development. Our mission is to provide a comprehensive curriculum to learn web development for free. We help users learn the skills and build the impressive portfolio of projects they need to get hired as a web developer. Some of the topics we cover include: - Ruby - Ruby on Rails - SQL - HTML and CSS - Javascript - Node - React - How to go about getting a job in the industry This repo contains the…
